# Bluent

> Bluent is a Blazor-native UI toolkit for building modern, component-rich business applications with forms, navigation, feedback, overlays, data presentation, charts, diagrams, and desktop-style interaction patterns.

Bluent is open source under Apache License 2.0. The current repository targets .NET 10. Blazor WebAssembly is the verified onboarding path; additional Blazor Web App interactive render modes are being validated.

## Start here

## Optional package retrieval families

All tracked optional-package retrieval families are source verified. Closely related public helper/configuration types are documented with the consumer workflow that uses them.

### Bluent.UI.Charts

- [Chart composition](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/chart.md): `Chart`, typed `Dataset`, legend/title/subtitle/tooltip plugins, scales, chart types, and related configuration
- [Gauge](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/gauge.md): JS-backed gauge and value formatting/configuration

### Bluent.UI.Diagrams

- [Diagram / DrawingCanvas](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/diagram.md): drawing/diagram surface, selection, tools, pan/scale/delete integration, commands
- [Basic shapes](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/diagram-shapes.md): `Circle`, `Line`, and `Rect`

### Bluent.UI.Utilities

- [AppBusyIndicator](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/app-busy-indicator.md): busy service and indicator component
- [Hierarchy](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/hierarchy-utilities.md): tree/item browsing and hierarchy selection workflows
- [MdiTab](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/mdi-tabs.md): MDI documents, tabs, service, and lifecycle
- [ToolbarButtons](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/toolbar-buttons.md): save/undo/redo helpers backed by `CommandManager`

The maintained [inventory](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/inventory.md) currently contains 65 source-verified consumer retrieval families in total: 57 main UI, 2 Charts, 2 Diagrams, and 4 Utilities.

## Canonical facts for code generation

- Main NuGet package: `Bluent.UI`
- Component namespace: `Bluent.UI.Components`
- Service registration namespace: `Bluent.UI.Extensions`
- Registration: `builder.Services.AddBluentUI();`
- Shared overlay host: one `<Containers />` in the active layout
- Required base styles: `_content/Bluent.UI/bluent.ui.theme.default.min.css` and `_content/Bluent.UI/bluent.ui.components.min.css`
- The base JavaScript module is loaded through Blazor JS interop; do not add an unverified global script tag
- Optional packages: `Bluent.UI.Charts`, `Bluent.UI.Diagrams`, and `Bluent.UI.Utilities`
- Do not invent APIs or claim render-mode compatibility that canonical documentation marks unverified
